newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta's share index down 9.83 points.
newsitem.headline: Malta's share index down 9.83 points.

text.p: Malta stock exchange share index dropped 9.83 points to 1009.46 as shares in one of the banks traded ex-dividend at the once-weekly trading session on Wednesday.
The market saw a turnover of just over Lm804,700 ($2.2 million) from the previous week's Lm463,000. Trading was spread over 83 deals of which 36 were in equities and 47 in fixed income securities.

Business in equities amounted to just over Lm34,680, with 27,845 shares being transacted. Of these, 12,026 were Bank of Valletta BKA.MT shares, transacted for an average of 125 cents, unchanged from last week.
There were six deals in Mid-Med Bank, currently trading ex-div, with 9,200 shares selling for an average 150 cents each, down seven cents from last week.

In Lombard Bank Malta, 1,200 shares changed hands for an average 150.8 cents per share, practically unchanged, while 1,308 shares in Middle Sea Insurance sold for an average 123 cents each, also unchanged.

A total of 3,502 Farsons ordinary shares changed hands for an average 52 cents per share, up one cent since last traded two weeks ago. The average price of Farsons 8.5 percent preference shares 1996/99 lost five mils, with 609 shares selling for an average 100.5 cents.
In the government bond market, 11 issues were dealt in, turnover reaching Lm763,380. Business was mainly in the 7.25 percent MGS 2006 (II), the 7.5 percent MGS 2011, and the 6.7 percent MGS 2004.
